title: Pitch shift
summary: Raise or lower the pitch by a number of semitones, keeping the duration. Keeps the voice's formants (its character) by default; without them a voice sounds smaller going up and larger going down. The result is altered audio: labelled processed, not factual.

params.title: Shift
params.help: Positive raises the pitch, negative lowers it; 12 is an octave, 0.01 a cent.

params.title: Keep the formants
params.help: Keep the spectral envelope where it is, so a voice keeps its character. Off, the envelope moves with the pitch.
